remove_complete_already_existing_declara.canonical_source:
/-- The genuine restricted local coherence condition supplies the actual Oka finite presentation. -/
theorem idealFGAt_of_coherentOn {n : ℕ} (I : GermIdeal n (ComplexModel n))
    (W : Set (ComplexModel n)) (hI : CoherentOn I W) {y : ComplexModel n} (hy : y ∈ W) :
    IdealFGAt I.mem y := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hyU, _hUW, N, H, hH, hgen⟩ := hI y hy
  refine ⟨U, hU, hyU, Fin N, inferInstance, H,
    fun i => mdifferentiableOn_iff_differentiableOn.mp (hH i), ?_⟩
  intro z hz g
  rw [hgen z hz g, CoherentIdealColon.isInSpanAt_range_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hg, a, ha, he⟩
    exact ⟨hg.mono (fun _ h => h.differentiableAt), a,
      fun i => (ha i).mono (fun _ h => h.differentiableAt), he⟩
  · rintro ⟨hg, a, ha, he⟩
    exact ⟨hg.mono (fun _ h => h.mdifferentiableAt), a,
      fun i => (ha i).mono (fun _ h => h.mdifferentiableAt), he⟩

remove_complete_already_existing_declara.name: mk_mem_originalOriginIdeal_iff_of_local
remove_complete_already_existing_declara.canonical_source:
/-- The literal WHOLE origin ideal has the actual representative dictionary from local generation alone. -/
theorem mk_mem_originalOriginIdeal_iff_of_local {n : ℕ} (I : GermIdeal n (ComplexModel n))
    (hI : IdealFGAt I.mem 0) {f : ComplexModel n → ℂ} (hf : HolAt f 0) :
    HolGerm.mk f hf ∈ originalCoherentOriginIdeal I ↔ I.mem 0 f := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, hU, h0U, μ, hμ, S, hS, hgen⟩ := hI
  let := hμ
  have hS0 : ∀ i, HolAt (S i) 0 := fun i => holAt_of_differentiableOn hU (hS i) h0U
  let K := Ideal.span (range fun i => HolGerm.mk (S i) (hS0 i))
  have hdict (g : ComplexModel n → ℂ) (hg : HolAt g 0) : I.mem 0 g ↔ HolGerm.mk g hg ∈ K :=
    (hgen 0 h0U g).trans (inSpanAt_zero_iff_mem_origin_span S hS0 hg)
  have hK : originalCoherentOriginIdeal I = K := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      rintro g ⟨a, ha, hIa, rfl⟩
      exact (hdict a ha).mp hIa
    · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      rintro g ⟨i, rfl⟩
      apply Ideal.subset_span
      exact ⟨S i, hS0 i, (hgen 0 h0U _).mpr (inSpanAt_self hS0 i), rfl⟩
  rw [hK]
  exact (hdict f hf).symm

remove_complete_already_existing_declara.name: whole_original_stalk_dictionary_at_actual_target
remove_complete_already_existing_declara.canonical_source:
/-- ANY fixed original flattening has the ENTIRE actual original stalk map/comap at EVERY real target point. -/
theorem whole_original_stalk_dictionary_at_actual_target
    (A : GermIdeal n M) (hA : A.IsCoherent) (x : M)
    (Φ : LocalHolomorphicEquivAt (chartAt (ComplexModel n) x x))
    (hsrc : Φ.source ⊆ (chartAt (ComplexModel n) x).target)
    (a : ComplexModel n) (ha : a ∈ Φ.target) :
    let y := actualFlatteningInverseMap x Φ a
    let hy := actualNearbyPoint_mem_chart_source x Φ hsrc a ha
    let E := actualNearbyGermEquiv Φ a ha
    let Ia := originalCoherentOriginIdeal (actualTranslatedOriginalSheaf (actualFlattenedOriginalSheaf A x Φ) a)
    Ideal.map E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom Ia = wholeChartStalkIdeal A x y hy ∧
      Ia = Ideal.comap E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom (wholeChartStalkIdeal A x y hy) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨O,hO,_hyO,N,G,hG,hgen,U,hU,haU,_hUT,hMap,hH,hF⟩ :=
    exists_local_original_pullback_generators A hA Φ.target Φ.isOpen_target
      (actualFlatteningInverseMap_mdifferentiable x Φ hsrc) a ha
  let y := actualFlatteningInverseMap x Φ a
  let hy := actualNearbyPoint_mem_chart_source x Φ hsrc a ha
  let E := actualNearbyGermEquiv Φ a ha
  let Ia := originalCoherentOriginIdeal (actualTranslatedOriginalSheaf (actualFlattenedOriginalSheaf A x Φ) a)
  have hhol : ∀ i, HolAt ((G i ∘ actualFlatteningInverseMap x Φ) ∘ actualAffineTranslation n a) 0 :=
    fun i => translated_function_holAt hU (hH i) haU
  have hI := translated_origin_ideal_eq_span_of_real_generators
    (actualFlattenedOriginalSheaf A x Φ) (fun i => G i ∘ actualFlatteningInverseMap x Φ)
      hU hH hF haU hhol
  have hGy (i : Fin N) : HolomorphicAt n (G i) y :=
    holomorphicAt_of_mdifferentiableOn hO (hG i) (hMap haU)
  have hwhole := wholeChartStalkIdeal_eq_span_of_original_generators A x y hy G hGy (hgen y (hMap haU))
  have hmap : Ideal.map E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom Ia = wholeChartStalkIdeal A x y hy := by
    dsimp only [Ia]
    rw [hI,Ideal.map_span,hwhole]
    congr 1
    ext g
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_,⟨i,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i,(actualNearbyGermEquiv_original_function x Φ hsrc a ha
        (G i) (hGy i) (hhol i)).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨i,rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_,⟨i,rfl⟩,actualNearbyGermEquiv_original_function x Φ hsrc a ha
        (G i) (hGy i) (hhol i)⟩
  refine ⟨hmap,?_⟩
  rw [← hmap,Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom E.bijective]

remove_complete_already_existing_declara.canonical_source:
/-- A coherent ideal is invertible if its actual restrictions to a covering family
of open subsets are invertible. -/
theorem isInvertible_of_open_cover {𝔞 : GermIdeal n Y} (h𝔞 : 𝔞.IsCoherent)
    (O : ι → Opens Y) (hcover : ∀ y : Y, ∃ i, y ∈ O i)
    (hinv : ∀ i, (GermIdeal.pullback (m := n) (Subtype.val : O i → Y) 𝔞).IsInvertible) :
    𝔞.IsInvertible := by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨i, hy⟩ := hcover y
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hyU, h, hh, hnon, hgen⟩ := hinv i ⟨y, hy⟩
  let H := extendOpens (O i) h
  have hH : H ∘ (Subtype.val : O i → Y) = h :=
    funext fun q => extendOpens_val (O i) h q
  refine ⟨Subtype.val '' U, (O i).isOpen.isOpenMap_subtype_val U hU,
    ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hyU, rfl⟩, H, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro z ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
    have hq' : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℂ, ComplexModel n) 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ)
        (H ∘ (Subtype.val : O i → Y)) q := by
      rw [hH]
      exact (hh q hq).mdifferentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq)
    exact ((mdifferentiableAt_comp_val_iff (O i)).mp hq').mdifferentiableWithinAt
  · rintro W hW hWU ⟨z, hz⟩
    have hsub : (Subtype.val : O i → Y) ⁻¹' W ⊆ U := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨q', hq', he⟩ := hWU hq
      exact (Subtype.ext he : q' = q) ▸ hq'
    have hne : ((Subtype.val : O i → Y) ⁻¹' W).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨q, _, he⟩ := hWU hz
      refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
      change q.val ∈ W
      rw [he]
      exact hz
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hq0⟩ := hnon _ (hW.preimage continuous_subtype_val) hsub hne
    exact ⟨q.val, hq, by simpa only [H, extendOpens_val] using hq0⟩
  · rintro z ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ g
    have hge : extendOpens (O i) (g ∘ Subtype.val) =ᶠ[𝓝 q.val] g := by
      filter_upwards [(O i).isOpen.mem_nhds q.property] with z hz
      exact extendOpens_val (O i) (g ∘ Subtype.val) ⟨z, hz⟩
    constructor
    · intro hg
      have hlocal := (hgen q hq (g ∘ Subtype.val)).mp
        (MarkedIdealRestrictOpen.comp_val_mem_pullback_val (O i) h𝔞 hg)
      have hspan : IsInSpanAt (n := n) (· = H) q.val
          (extendOpens (O i) (g ∘ Subtype.val)) :=
        (isInSpanAt_comp_val_iff (O i)).mp (hlocal.mono fun s hs => by
          exact ⟨H, rfl, hs.trans hH.symm⟩)
      exact IsInSpanAt.congr' hspan hge
    · intro hg
      have hlocal : IsInSpanAt (n := n) (· = h) q (g ∘ Subtype.val) :=
        (isInSpanAt_comp contMDiff_subtype_val hg).mono fun s hs => by
          obtain ⟨s', rfl, rfl⟩ := hs
          exact hH
      have hmem := (MarkedIdealRestrictOpen.mem_pullback_val_iff (O i) h𝔞).mp
        ((hgen q hq (g ∘ Subtype.val)).mpr hlocal)
      exact HomogenizedIdeal.mem_congr h𝔞 hmem hge

remove_complete_already_existing_declara.name: iterDerivIdeal_iterDerivIdeal
remove_complete_already_existing_declara.canonical_source:
/-- `𝓓^j(𝓓^i 𝔞) = 𝓓^{i+j} 𝔞`. -/
theorem iterDerivIdeal_iterDerivIdeal (𝔞 : GermIdeal n M) (i : ℕ) :
    ∀ j, iterDerivIdeal (iterDerivIdeal 𝔞 i) j = iterDerivIdeal 𝔞 (i + j)
  | 0 => rfl
  | j + 1 => by
    rw [iterDerivIdeal_succ, iterDerivIdeal_iterDerivIdeal 𝔞 i j, ← Nat.add_assoc,
      iterDerivIdeal_succ]

IsMaximalOrder.iterDerivIdeal
remove_complete_already_existing_declara.canonical_source:
/-- **Derivatives of a marked ideal of maximal order** are of maximal order:
`(𝓓^i 𝔞, μ - i)` for `i ≤ μ`. -/
theorem IsMaximalOrder.iterDerivIdeal {𝔞 : GermIdeal n M} {μ : ℕ} (h : IsMaximalOrder 𝔞 μ)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ μ) : IsMaximalOrder (DerivativeIdeal.iterDerivIdeal 𝔞 i) (μ - i) := by
  intro x
  rw [iterDerivIdeal_iterDerivIdeal, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hi]
  exact h x

remove_complete_already_existing_declara.name: cosupport_add_subset_cosupport_iterDerivIdeal
remove_complete_already_existing_declara.canonical_source:
/-- **Giraud's inclusion, iterated** (`N = M`): `cosupp(𝔞, μ + j) ⊆ cosupp(𝓓^j 𝔞, μ)`. -/
theorem cosupport_add_subset_cosupport_iterDerivIdeal (𝔞 : GermIdeal n M) (μ : ℕ) :
    ∀ j, cosupport n univ 𝔞 (μ + j) ⊆ cosupport n univ (iterDerivIdeal 𝔞 j) μ
  | 0 => subset_rfl
  | j + 1 => by
    have h1 : cosupport n univ 𝔞 (μ + (j + 1)) ⊆ cosupport n univ (iterDerivIdeal 𝔞 j) (μ + 1) := by
      rw [show μ + (j + 1) = (μ + 1) + j by omega]
      exact cosupport_add_subset_cosupport_iterDerivIdeal 𝔞 (μ + 1) j
    exact h1.trans (cosupport_succ_subset_cosupport_derivIdeal μ)

remove_complete_already_existing_declara.name: exists_restrict_step
remove_complete_already_existing_declara.canonical_source:
/-- **Restriction of a one-step extension**: the restriction to `U` of `T` followed by a blowup is the restriction of `T`
followed by a blowup (along the trace of the centre); so restricted growing sequences are growing. -/
theorem exists_restrict_step (U : Opens X) {Y Z : CMfd.{u} n} (T : BlowupTower X Y) (C : Set Y) (π : Z → Y)
    (hπ : IsBlowupAlong n C π) :
    ∃ (π' : openPreimage (.step T C π hπ) U → openPreimage T U)
      (hπ' : IsBlowupAlong n ((Subtype.val : openPreimage T U → Y) ⁻¹' C) π'),
      restrict U (.step T C π hπ) = .step (restrict U T) ((Subtype.val : openPreimage T U → Y) ⁻¹' C) π' hπ' :=
  ⟨_, _, rfl⟩

remove_complete_already_existing_declara.name: proj_mem_cosupp_append
remove_complete_already_existing_declara.canonical_source:
/-- **Along a multiple test blow-up `T S` the points of the cosupport lie over the cosupport at `T`** (closed submanifold `N`,
coherent ideal; one step at a time, `StepOneWellFounded.proj_mem_cosupp_step`). -/
theorem proj_mem_cosupp_append (hN : IsClosedSubmanifold n 𝔪.N) (h𝔞 : 𝔪.ideal.IsCoherent) {Y₀ : CMfd.{u} n}
    (T : BlowupTower X Y₀) :
    ∀ {Y : CMfd.{u} n} (S : BlowupTower Y₀ Y), IsGeoTestTower 𝔪 (T.append S) →
      ∀ z ∈ (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 (T.append S)).cosupp, S.proj z ∈ (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 T).cosupp
  | _, .refl, _, z, hz => hz
  | _, .step S C π hπ, hT, z, hz => by
      have hT' : IsGeoTestTower 𝔪 (.step (T.append S) C π hπ) := hT
      have hπz := StepOneWellFounded.proj_mem_cosupp_step hN h𝔞 (T.append S) C π hπ hT' hz
      exact proj_mem_cosupp_append hN h𝔞 T S hT'.1 (π z) hπz

open Classical in

remove_complete_already_existing_declara.name: countCentresMeeting_eq_inter_cosupp
remove_complete_already_existing_declara.canonical_source:
/-- **After the stage `T` the centres meeting `K` are counted against the compact part of the cosupport**: along a multiple
test blow-up `T S` (closed submanifold `N`, coherent ideal), a centre of `S` meets the preimage of `T⁻¹K` iff it meets the
preimage of `T⁻¹K ∩ cosupp 𝔪_T` (the centres are admissible, hence in the cosupport, which lies over the cosupport at `T`). -/
theorem countCentresMeeting_eq_inter_cosupp (hN : IsClosedSubmanifold n 𝔪.N) (h𝔞 : 𝔪.ideal.IsCoherent) (K : Set X)
    {Y₀ : CMfd.{u} n} (T : BlowupTower X Y₀) :
    ∀ {Y : CMfd.{u} n} (S : BlowupTower Y₀ Y), IsGeoTestTower 𝔪 (T.append S) →
      countCentresMeeting (T.proj ⁻¹' K) S = countCentresMeeting (T.proj ⁻¹' K ∩ (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 T).cosupp) S
  | _, .refl, _ => rfl
  | _, .step S C π hπ, hT => by
      have hT' : IsGeoTestTower 𝔪 (.step (T.append S) C π hπ) := hT
      obtain ⟨hTS, hC⟩ := (isGeoTestTower_step_iff 𝔪 (T.append S) C π hπ).mp hT'
      have ih := countCentresMeeting_eq_inter_cosupp hN h𝔞 K T S hTS
      have hiff : (C ∩ S.proj ⁻¹' (T.proj ⁻¹' K)).Nonempty ↔
          (C ∩ S.proj ⁻¹' (T.proj ⁻¹' K ∩ (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 T).cosupp)).Nonempty := by
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨c, hcC, hcK⟩
          exact ⟨c, hcC, hcK, proj_mem_cosupp_append hN h𝔞 T S hTS c (hC.2.1 hcC)⟩
        · rintro ⟨c, hcC, hcK, -⟩
          exact ⟨c, hcC, hcK⟩
      show countCentresMeeting (T.proj ⁻¹' K) S + (if (C ∩ S.proj ⁻¹' (T.proj ⁻¹' K)).Nonempty then 1 else 0) =
        countCentresMeeting (T.proj ⁻¹' K ∩ (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 T).cosupp) S +
          (if (C ∩ S.proj ⁻¹' (T.proj ⁻¹' K ∩ (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 T).cosupp)).Nonempty then 1 else 0)
      rw [ih]
      by_cases h1 : (C ∩ S.proj ⁻¹' (T.proj ⁻¹' K)).Nonempty
      · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos (hiff.mp h1)]
      · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg (fun h2 => h1 (hiff.mpr h2))]

section GenuineLocalAlgebras
variable {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra ℂ R] [Algebra ℂ S]
  [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S]

/-- The genuine original local algebra map retains ALL actual ambient maximal-power quotient classes. -/
def actualLocalAmbientJetAlgEquiv (E : R ≃ₐ[ℂ] S) (I : Ideal R) (s : ℕ) :
    (R ⧸ (I ⊔ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ^ s)) ≃ₐ[ℂ]
      (S ⧸ (Ideal.map E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom I ⊔ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S ^ s)) :=
  Ideal.quotientEquivAlg _ _ E (by
    rw [Ideal.map_sup,Ideal.map_pow,
      IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective (E : R →+* S) E.surjective]
    rfl)

/-- EVERY original ambient numerator keeps its SAME actual whole algebra image. -/
theorem actualLocalAmbientJetAlgEquiv_mk (E : R ≃ₐ[ℂ] S) (I : Ideal R) (s : ℕ) (g : R) :
    actualLocalAmbientJetAlgEquiv E I s
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ⊔ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ^ s) g) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (Ideal.map E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom I ⊔ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S ^ s) (E g) := rfl

end GenuineLocalAlgebras

/-- The EXISTING original ambient HS is invariant under every genuine original complex germ algebra equivalence. -/
theorem actualAmbientHS_eq_of_genuineAlgEquiv {n : ℕ}
    (E : HolGerm (ComplexModel n) ≃ₐ[ℂ] HolGerm (ComplexModel n))
    (I : Ideal (HolGerm (ComplexModel n))) (ℓ : ℕ) :
    hilbertSamuelValue (Ideal.map E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom I) ℓ = hilbertSamuelValue I ℓ :=
  (actualLocalAmbientJetAlgEquiv E I (ℓ+1)).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq.symm

section Manifold
variable {n : ℕ} {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M]
  [ChartedSpace (ComplexModel n) M] [IsComplexManifold n M]

/-- ANY fixed actual nonlinear flattening retains the SAME WHOLE original chart-stalk ambient HS at EVERY true target point. -/
theorem fixed_real_original_whole_stalk_ambient_hs_dictionary
    (A : GermIdeal n M) (hA : A.IsCoherent) (x : M)
    (Φ : LocalHolomorphicEquivAt (chartAt (ComplexModel n) x x))
    (hsrc : Φ.source ⊆ (chartAt (ComplexModel n) x).target)
    (a : ComplexModel n) (ha : a ∈ Φ.target) (ℓ : ℕ) :
    let y := actualFlatteningInverseMap x Φ a
    let hy := actualNearbyPoint_mem_chart_source x Φ hsrc a ha
    hilbertSamuelValue (wholeChartStalkIdeal A x y hy) ℓ =
      hilbertSamuelValue
        (originalCoherentOriginIdeal (actualTranslatedOriginalSheaf (actualFlattenedOriginalSheaf A x Φ) a)) ℓ := by
  dsimp only
  have hmap := (whole_original_stalk_dictionary_at_actual_target A hA x Φ hsrc a ha).1
  rw [← hmap]
  exact actualAmbientHS_eq_of_genuineAlgEquiv (actualNearbyGermEquiv Φ a ha) _ ℓ

end Manifold
